<!--
Shared chart color palette, spliced into every report page via
{{< include _chart_theme.qmd >}} (same literal-text-splice mechanism as
_calib_run_selector.qmd -- these cells execute in the including page's own
OJS runtime, not a separate document). Pure OJS, no Python dependency, so
include order relative to _calib_run_selector.qmd doesn't matter.

Replaces the old, inconsistent per-page defaults (navy/olive #376092 /
#77933c on most pages, "steelblue"/"forestgreen"/"orange" on others) with
one palette used everywhere -- muted/earthy tones (denim, red rock,
sagebrush, aspen) rather than saturated web-safe colors. Meaning stays
consistent site-wide:

  themeModel          Modeled data, always
  themeObserved       Observed/survey data (primary source)
  themeObservedAlt    A second, distinct observed source in the same chart
                       (e.g. an older survey year shown alongside a newer one)
  themeObservedLight  Faded/secondary variant of Observed (e.g. a
                       distribution band behind an Observed mean marker)
  themeAccent         Extra category beyond Model/Observed (e.g. a
                       calibration target line)
  themeNeutral        Neutral/reference series, not itself Model or Observed
  themeDanger         Over-threshold / error highlight
-->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
themeModel = "#6E8CA0"
themeObserved = "#C68958"
themeObservedAlt = "#7C9A78"
themeObservedLight = "#E6D6B8"
themeAccent = "#8B7398"
themeNeutral = "#7D7568"
themeDanger = "#A8412C"
```
